description:
We’re Zero-G Forge, a passionate team of makers and students from Private KOSBI Z.M.C. Technical High School, Turkey. We focus on zero-g systems, robotics, 3D CAD, rapid prototyping, and data. We are eager to turn NASA data into a real, impactful project.

Why join? We offer a highly collaborative, hands-on, and energetic environment where your ideas will shape the build.
